description: Boson AI conversational TTS model for expressive speech across 100+ languages, zero-shot voice cloning, and inline control over emotion, style, prosody, pauses, and sound effects.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated AR tokens; default 2048, and 0 also uses the default.

request.name: temperature
request.description: AR sampling temperature; must be positive when set; default 0.8.

request.name: top_p
request.description: AR nucleus sampling probability in (0, 1]; default 0.8.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Accepted for API compatibility and validated as positive; current Higgs audio sampling does not consume it; default 1.1.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for reproducible output; omitted uses a random seed.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript or prompt text paired with reference audio for zero-shot voice cloning.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum characters per generated text chunk; default 1024.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking mode; default word_budget.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: AR and codec weight storage type; default native.

session.name: ar_weight_type
session.description: Autoregressive decoder weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: codec_weight_type
session.description: Codec weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: ar_weight_context_mb
session.description: AR weight context size in MiB; default 4096.

session.name: codec_weight_context_mb
session.description: Codec weight context size in MiB; default 1536.

session.name: ar_decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: AR decode graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: codec_decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec decode graph arena size in MiB; default 128.

session.name: codec_encode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Codec encode graph arena size in MiB; default 256.
